description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Wondrous Mirage Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Wondrous Mirage Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Wondrous Mirage after using two Wind abilities

description.name: Wondrous Mirage
description.text: Six single hybrid ranged attacks (0.32 or 1.32 each), 100% hit rate, causes [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Wind 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Buff Wind 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
